default_creds.context: MinIO S3 storage at port 9080 -- stores all LLM request/response bodies
Auth secret default literal value from self-hosted config

misconfig_patterns: Port 8585 (Jawn API) requires no authentication -- anyone with network access can proxy LLM requests
MinIO at port 9080 with default creds minioadmin/minioadmin -- all stored request/response bodies exposed
Auth secret 'change-me-in-production' not changed -- predictable for brute force
Dashboard signup open by default -- anyone can create account and view org's LLM data
No HTTPS by default -- all LLM prompts/responses in plaintext on network

active_probe.false_positive_check: page title or body must contain Helicone

deployment_tells: Port 8585 Jawn proxy -- no auth required for LLM proxying
Self-hosted path in maintenance mode -- SaaS is primary product
pivot_paths: GET :8585/ -- no-auth LLM proxy; all requests logged with full prompt/response bodies
GET :9080/ + login minioadmin/minioadmin -- MinIO browser shows all stored request body objects
POST :8585/v1/chat/completions -- proxy LLM calls through victim's Helicone account; logs to their dashboard
Dashboard at :3000 -- open signup allows creating account; view usage analytics
